fields.label: Custom Features
fields.help: A list of features enabled when the selected profile is CUSTOM.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Min TLS Version
fields.help: The minimum version of SSL protocol that can be used by the clients to establish a connection with the load balancer.

fields.label: Profile
fields.help: Profile specifies the set of SSL features that can be used by the load balancer when negotiating SSL with clients.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: The region where the regional SSL policy resides.
